create_test_task_run: create a test task run in the MephistoDB with optional task and requester IDs
create_test_assignment: create a test assignment linked to a task run in the MephistoDB
create_test_unit: create a test unit for an assignment with a specified unit index and pay amount
create_completed_unit: create a completed unit by assigning a worker to an incomplete task run
query_worker_reviews: query worker review records filtered by qualification ID, worker ID, and optional task ID
